title: Couples Supported by One Person's CPF LIFE Payout
what_it_is: Couples Supported by One Person's CPF LIFE Payout

sections.label: CPF balances and schemes
sections.summary: Older cohorts may opt into CPF LIFE, most remain under RSS, and average CPF balances at age 64 in 2017 were $118,000 for males and $91,500 for females.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Older cohorts can opt in to CPF LIFE on a voluntary basis, but most of them are still under the Retirement Sum Scheme (RSS), which does not provide lifelong payouts.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As CPF accounts are maintained and managed as individual accounts, we do not have data on CPF accounts by households and couples.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For those aged 65 in 2018, the average CPF balance when they reached their Payout Eligibility Age of 64 in 2017 was $118,000 for males and $91,500 for females.

sections.label: Spousal CPF top-ups rise
sections.summary: Spousal transfers and top-ups rose from about $50 million in 2012 to quadruple in 2016, received by about 15,000 spouses.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If you look at the data in 2012, the transfers and top-ups to spouses amounted to about $50 million.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And then, if you fast forward to 2016, that amount of cash top-ups and transfers had quadrupled.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The number of cash top-ups and transfers received by spouses in 2016 came to about 15,000.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: To the Member's question, if I understand correctly, what about the remaining stream-outs that a member could have received, had he stayed alive?

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: I think from an actuarial standpoint, that would be very difficult.

sections.label: Reviewing spousal top-up rules
sections.summary: Rules will be reviewed from time to time to make cash top-ups or transfers to spouses easier where possible.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: When you add the complexity of a couple, I think that makes it much harder.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But I think what we will continue to do is to review the rules from time to time and where it is possible to do so, make it easier for people to make cash top-ups or transfers to their spouses.
